svg.title: Arable farmer — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as arable farmer, wearing a work jacket and a peaked work cap. Visible work cue: A grain stalk with separated kernels stands beside a crescent harvesting sickle and long handle. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a peaked work cap.
